text_block_list.text: Today is New Year's Day. I intended to have a meeting to prepare for the Classic tier, where the real racing truly begins, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Athbhliain faoi mhaise duit!
Happy New Year♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this?
I just did a little shopping!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, New Year's in Japan is really something, isn't it!
I'd heard stories about it, but it's so lively!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A lucky bag... is that what it's called?
The entire bag is stuffed full of happiness!
What a wonderful custom♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...It's a little too happy,
and rather heavy.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Now, our meeting... was about running the Triple Tiara route and aiming for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...*peek*.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All I have to do is give it my all on the track!
Anything from your end, Trainer?
choice_data_list: ...Let's do our best this year too! That is all!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
Finished already? It's nice and concise, wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to open the lucky bag~♪
*Clap clap*~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The ones catching my eye the most are... those three over there. Which one do you like, Trainer?

Checking the lucky bags
that Fine Motion pointed to...
choice_data_list: Lucky Bags - Limited to First 10 Customers

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that~!
It was super hard to buy, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Still, I was lucky! When I dropped by on a whim,
they had just one left.
Inside is...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm? Shoes!

Inside the lucky bag
was a pair of light-up shoes for children.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, so that's why~!
I did wonder why there were so many families around."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, glowing shoes are just too wonderful, but... I want them, but~... I probably shouldn't be the one keeping them, right?"

text_block_list.name: Facility Children
text_block_list.text:
Wah! So cool!
Thank you, Sis!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so glad you like it♪
Let's go for a run together with big sis in those shoes!

After that, Fine Motion bought even more shoes
and donated them to the children at the local welfare facility.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of bread is inside,
I can't wait to find out♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah! But if we're doing this—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Mmh~, delicious♪
Nothing goes with bread quite like a picnic!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yours is... anko bread, Trainer?
That looks delicious too!

And so, I spent a relaxing time eating bread
with Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu, doesn't that sound kind of fun?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Um, the contents are—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...A large fan, is it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that famous?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm not really sure what it is,
but it makes you want to wave it around fluffily!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just like this...
Huh-huuh♪

...Despite knowing nothing about it whatsoever,
Fine Motion somehow landed on the right answer
purely on vibes alone.
